title: Abalaleli Abavela Kokungabonwayo
intro: Ngale kwesihenqo sezwe elibonakalayo, umhlangano ofihliwe wawubuthene ebumnyameni, udonseleka emsindweni owawuphikisa konke ababekwazi. Babezulazule iminyaka eminingi bengenaso isiqondiso seqiniso, kwaze kwaba yilapho izwi lihlaba ekuthuleni kombuso wabo ongabonakali futhi lishukumisa okuthile okujulile ngaphakathi. Namuhla ebusuku, umenywa ukuba udlule emthunzini futhi wembule ukuthi ungubani leli qembu eliyimfihlakalo, ukuhlangana kwalo namazwi aphezulu kwabaholela emuva kubantu balo njengezixwayiso zeqiniso elingenakuvinjelwa.
clues: Siyizidalwa zasendulo, ezazikhona kudala ngaphambi kwezizwe eziningi oke wafunda ngazo, kodwa akuvamile ukuthi kukhulunywe ngathi ezindabeni zabantu.
Imvelo yethu ayifani neyakho, ithungwe ngezinto ezingabonakali, futhi sinamandla aphikisana nokujwayelekile.
Sekuyisikhathi eside sizulazula ngaphandle kwesiqondiso sangempela, kwaze kwaba yilapho kufika umsindo kithi owawushukumisa okuthile okujulile ngaphakathi.
Sezwa ukuphindaphindwa okungenakuqhathaniswa esake sakuzwa, amazwi ayenesisindo esingaphezu kwanoma iyiphi inkulumo.
Sasondela ngasese, sayala abethu ukuba bathule, kwathi lapho amavesi ephela, asikwazanga ukuhlala sithule.
Sabuyela kubantu bakithi sathi: 'O bantu bakithi, sizwile incwadi eyambulwa ngemva kukaMose, iqinisekisa okwakungaphambi kwayo, iqondisa eqinisweni.'

verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
